userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 ModerationFlow 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、审核算法、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、主要风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.advanceGate: Authorities and privacy boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 Content、Evidence、Policy、Review、Appeal、Audit、Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 的职责边界。

scenes.title: Review flows
scenes.objective: Explain success, escalation, appeal, and atomic rejection flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Frozen inputs and forbidden partial state are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释一次多级审核、一次 Appeal 和一次必须原子拒绝的完整状态与数据流。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author API, state, error, event, and audit contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Public contracts are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、Work、Event、Audit 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.advanceGate: Tests cover independent invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、PostgreSQL Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery、Audit 和 Performance 各验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.advanceGate: All roles boot and stop.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and invalid references are atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证合法导入、重放、冲突、跨租户引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Policy versions
scenes.advanceGate: One active version and activation boundary hold.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Policy、PolicyVersion、严格校验、激活和提交边界并验证。

scenes.title: Content and evidence
scenes.objective: Implement immutable content and evidence versions.
scenes.advanceGate: Evidence heads are contiguous and fenced.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 ContentItem、EvidenceVersion、expected head、版本竞争和 Case 冻结输入。

scenes.title: Level one review
scenes.advanceGate: Each outcome opens the correct next state once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 LEVEL_1 queue、claim、ALLOW/RESTRICT/REMOVE/ESCALATE 和唯一后继 Stage。

scenes.title: Level two races
scenes.advanceGate: Competing decisions produce one terminal lineage.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 LEVEL_2、lease fencing、相反决策并发和 stale reviewer 拒绝。

scenes.title: Appeals
scenes.advanceGate: One timely appeal appends but never edits history.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Appeal 时限、冻结证据、UPHOLD/OVERTURN 和重复 Appeal 竞争。

scenes.title: Audit and events
scenes.objective: Implement immutable audit and transactional events.
scenes.advanceGate: Digest chain and event identities survive retry.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成事务性 AuditEntry、tenant digest chain、Event 顺序和 dispatcher 未知 ACK 恢复。

scenes.title: Replay and worker recovery
scenes.objective: Prove idempotency and fenced work recovery.
scenes.advanceGate: Lost responses and killed workers create one effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证响应丢失、API 重启、双 API 重放、Barrier SIGKILL 和替代 Worker。

scenes.title: Operations UI
scenes.advanceGate: Visible workflows cover V1.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 驱动的 Policy、Content、Evidence、Review、Appeal 和 Audit UI。

scenes.title: Browser and integration
scenes.objective: Complete real database and browser tests.
scenes.advanceGate: Production Chromium covers the primary journey.
scenes.safeMessage: 请补齐真实 PostgreSQL Integration 和 production Chromium 多级审核与 Appeal 端到端测试。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Run races, crashes, isolation, and findings-first review.
scenes.advanceGate: No unresolved V1 finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行双 API/双 Worker、审核竞争、Barrier SIGKILL、租户隔离和 Audit 校验，并做 V1 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan is complete before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Trust & Safety Manager】新增 PolicyRecallRun 与 append-only Reconsideration。本消息是完整公开合同。recalledPolicyVersionId 必须是该 tenant 已被替代或撤销的版本，replacementPolicyVersionId 必须是同一 Policy 当前 ACTIVE 版本。创建事务冻结闭区间 decidedFrom/decidedTo 内使用 recalled version 的全部终态 Case ID、finalDecisionId 和 evidenceHeadVersion；replacement 缺少任一冻结 Decision.categoryCode 时整批以 POLICY_RECALL_POLICY_INCOMPATIBLE 拒绝。POLICY_RECALL Work.aggregateId=policyRecallRunId。Worker 以 replacement category.level1Action 生成 suggestedOutcome；每个冻结 Case append 恰好一条 Reconsideration。建议改变才创建恰好一个 RECONSIDERATION ReviewStage，人工只能决定 ALLOW、RESTRICT 或 REMOVE；建议相同记录 NO_CHANGE 且不创建 Stage。不得改写原 Case、Stage、Decision、Appeal、EvidenceVersion 或 AuditEntry。PolicyRecallRun = {policyRecallRunId:uuid,tenantId:uuid,recalledPolicyVersionId:uuid,replacementPolicyVersionId:uuid,decidedFrom:timestamp,decidedTo:timestamp,state:PENDING|RUNNING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED,totalCount:int,completedCount:int,changedCount:int,noChangeCount:int,createdAt:timestamp,completedAt:timestamp|null,cancelledAt:timestamp|null}。Reconsideration = {reconsiderationId:uuid,policyRecallRunId:uuid,caseId:uuid,evidenceHeadVersion:int,oldDecisionId:uuid,oldOutcome:ALLOW|RESTRICT|REMOVE,suggestedOutcome:ALLOW|RESTRICT|REMOVE|ESCALATE,replacementPolicyVersionId:uuid,outcome:CHANGED|NO_CHANGE,reason:string,reconsiderationStageId:uuid|null,createdAt:timestamp}。FINAL 将 ReviewStage.level 扩展为 LEVEL_1|LEVEL_2|APPEAL|RECONSIDERATION。completedCount=changedCount+noChangeCount<=totalCount。取消只阻止未开始 Work，已提交 Reconsideration 和 Stage 保留；取消与最后提交竞争只能序列化为 COMPLETED 或 CANCELLED。公开接口：POST /api/v1/policy-recall-runs，body {tenantId,recalledPolicyVersionId,replacementPolicyVersionId,decidedFrom,decidedTo}，返回 201 PolicyRecallRun；GET /api/v1/policy-recall-runs/:runId，返回 200 {run:PolicyRecallRun,reconsiderations:[Reconsideration]}；POST /api/v1/policy-recall-runs/:runId/cancel，body {}，返回 200 PolicyRecallRun。所有 mutation 继承 V1 Idempotency-Key、未知字段拒绝和稳定错误 envelope。新增穷举错误：409 POLICY_RECALL_VERSION_MISMATCH、409 POLICY_RECALL_RUN_TERMINAL、409 POLICY_RECALL_POLICY_INCOMPATIBLE、400 POLICY_RECALL_RANGE_INVALID、400 INVALID_REQUEST；缺失 ID 为 404 NOT_FOUND。UI 提供 Recall 创建、进度、差异、取消、Reconsideration 和人工确认；并发创建、取消、Worker SIGKILL 和旧 lease 不得重复结果或越过 fence。迁移保留 V1 identity、saved replay、pending Work、Event 和 audit chain。本轮只做影响分析和分阶段计划，不要编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更的 schema、API、Worker、迁移、并发、UI 和测试影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.advanceGate: V1 lineages and audit chain survive.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Evidence、Case、Decision、Appeal、replay、Work、Event 和 Audit 不变。

scenes.title: Recall execution
scenes.advanceGate: One append-only result exists per frozen case.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 PolicyRecallRun、冻结集合、Reconsideration、人工确认 Stage、取消 fence 和 Worker 恢复。

scenes.title: Manager UI and races
scenes.objective: Complete recall UI and realistic tests.
scenes.advanceGate: Browser, cancel, and lease races pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Recall UI、Integration、Chromium、Concurrency 和 SIGKILL Recovery 测试。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告真实吞吐、延迟、恢复时间和负载后 lineage/Audit 不变量。

scenes.title: Full regression
scenes.objective: Run aggregate regression and privacy review.
scenes.advanceGate: All gates and privacy checks pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行完整非性能 gate，复核租户隔离、私有证据不泄漏、Event 顺序、Work 排空和 Audit chain。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff is accurate and evidence-backed.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，并给出准确交付证据、风险和未运行项。
